papers.title: Uneven Evolution of Cognition Across Generations of Generative AI Models
papers.reason: Excluded because it psychometrically evaluates the cognitive abilities of generative AI models rather than human participants.

papers.title: ASR-Agnostic Multimodal Spectrotemporal Modeling for Early Dementia Detection
papers.reason: It develops a human dementia biomarker from elicited speech, but does not centrally analyze an interactive decision task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG, or a cognitive process model.

papers.title: Demystifying Video Reasoning
papers.reason: Excluded because it studies reasoning and working memory inside diffusion-based video generation models rather than human cognition.

papers.title: The Richest Paradigm You're Not Using: Commercial Videogames at the Intersection of Human-Computer Interaction and Cognitive Science
papers.reason: This perspective centrally proposes interactive commercial games with behavioral timing and eye tracking for studying human attention and executive function, although it reports no empirical dataset.

papers.title: Pupillometry and Brain Dynamics for Cognitive Load in Working Memory
papers.reason: It analyzes performance-related pupillometry and EEG during an interactive digit-span working-memory task, but the stated EEG method does not include qualifying spectral or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization
papers.reason: Excluded because it concerns video generation and KV-cache memory in machine-learning models rather than human participants.

papers.title: Cognitive Load Estimation Using Brain Foundation Models and Interpretability for BCIs
papers.reason: It addresses human EEG-based cognitive-load monitoring, but the summary specifies neither an interactive task nor frequency-domain or connectivity EEG methodology.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Computational Model of Brain-Heart Interactions via HRV and EEG Feature
papers.reason: It uses human working-memory task data, but its EEG contribution is limited to band-power and generic time-series features and its synthetic HRV model is not a cognitive decision-process model.

papers.title: Unveiling the Heart-Brain Connection: An Analysis of ECG in Cognitive Performance
papers.reason: It includes an active human working-memory paradigm, while the main method is ECG-to-EEG feature regression and the EEG analysis is limited to spectral and generic descriptors.

papers.title: Your Eyes Controlled the Game: Real-Time Cognitive Training Adaptation based on Eye-Tracking and Physiological Data in Virtual Reality
papers.reason: It centrally combines interactive adaptive VR tasks for attention and working memory with real-time eye tracking to estimate and regulate cognitive load.

papers.title: How Light Shapes Memory: Beta Synchrony in the Temporal-Parietal Cortex Predicts Cognitive Ergonomics for BCI Applications
papers.reason: It analyzes beta-phase EEG connectivity and regional synchrony during active recall and sequence working-memory tasks.

papers.title: Setting up for failure: automatic discovery of the neural mechanisms of cognitive errors
papers.reason: Excluded because its neural validation is based on macaque data rather than an exclusively human participant population.

papers.title: A Quantitative Framework for Assessing Sleep Quality from EEG Time Series in Complex Dynamic Systems
papers.reason: It combines a human working-memory task with frequency-domain EEG analyses including phase-amplitude coupling, beta power, and delta connectivity.

papers.title: Quantifying the Effects of Word Length, Frequency, and Predictability on Dyslexia
papers.reason: It centrally analyzes human eye-tracking measures as potential markers of dyslexic reading costs, but naturalistic reading is not an interactive decision task under the stated criterion.

papers.title: Working Memory Functional Connectivity Analysis for Dementia Classification using EEG
papers.reason: It uses active working-memory stages and detailed EEG functional-connectivity measures to classify healthy, MCI, and Alzheimer’s disease groups.

papers.title: Bayesian Distributional Models of Executive Functioning
papers.reason: It centrally develops Bayesian latent-variable inference and information-gain-based adaptive sampling for executive-function assessment using controlled simulations.

papers.title: Bibliometric-enhanced Systematic Literature Review of EEG in Education: Learning Concepts, Computational Methods, and Research Opportunities
papers.reason: It reviews EEG-based assessment of attention and learning but contributes no original human task, eye-tracking, qualifying EEG, or cognitive generative-model methodology.

papers.title: EEG-Based Framework for Reflexive and Perceptual Assessment in CLIS: Preliminary Study in Healthy Volunteers
papers.reason: It uses steady-state auditory and visual evoked EEG responses as frequency-specific cognitive-assessment measures, but the paradigms are passive rather than interactive.

papers.title: EEG-Based Cognitive Load Classification During Landmark-Based VR Navigation
papers.reason: It studies human decisions during interactive VR navigation, but reports EEG classification without sufficient frequency-domain or connectivity method detail to satisfy Element C.

papers.title: A Unified Cortical Circuit Model with Divisive Normalization and Self-Excitation for Robust Representation and Memory Maintenance
papers.reason: It presents a generative recurrent-circuit account of working-memory maintenance and approximate Bayesian belief updating in cognitive tasks.

papers.title: Dissociating Cognitive Load and Stress Responses Using Single-Channel EEG: Behavioral and Neural Correlates of Anxiety Across Cognitive States
papers.reason: It uses active auditory cognitive tasks with human participants, but the EEG analysis is limited to individual frequency-band summaries and machine-learned features rather than connectivity or detailed spectral dynamics.

papers.title: Sleep Brain and Cardiac Activity Predict Cognitive Flexibility and Conceptual Reasoning Using Deep Learning
papers.reason: It predicts human executive-function scores from passive sleep EEG and ECG, without an interactive recorded task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or a cognitive process model.

papers.title: Evaluating Cognitive Assessment Tools:A Comparative Analysis of MMSE, RUDAS, SAGE, ADAS and MoCA for Early Dementia Detection
papers.reason: It reviews conventional human dementia screening instruments but includes none of the specified behavioral, eye-tracking, EEG, or computational cognitive-model methodologies.

papers.title: Early Detection of Cognitive Impairment in Elderly using a Passive FPVS-EEG BCI and Machine Learning -- Extended Version
papers.reason: It targets early cognitive-impairment detection with passive EEG, but explicitly lacks behavioral interaction and reports CNN inference without qualifying frequency-domain or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: Immersive Virtual Reality Assessments of Working Memory and Psychomotor Skills: A Comparison between Immersive and Non-Immersive Assessments
papers.reason: Human participants perform interactive sequential working-memory and reaction-time tasks in VR and on a PC, but no eye tracking, EEG, or cognitive process model is included.

papers.title: Triangulating LLM Progress through Benchmarks, Games, and Cognitive Tests
papers.reason: Excluded because it evaluates LLM abilities using games and cognitive tests designed for AI models rather than human participants.

papers.title: Interactive Virtual Games: Winners for Deep Cognitive Assessment
papers.reason: It validates interactive cognitive minigames in a clinical human sample and analyzes continuous behavioral, movement, and gaze trajectories as individual cognitive profiles.

papers.title: Mazed and Confused: A Dataset of Cybersickness, Working Memory, Mental Load, Physical Load, and Attention During a Real Walking Task in VR
papers.reason: It records eye tracking and detailed behavior while human participants navigate VR mazes and perform attention and working-memory tasks.

papers.title: Pathformer3D: A 3D Scanpath Transformer for 360° Images
papers.reason: It centrally models human scanpaths from panoramic eye-tracking datasets, but focuses on passive image viewing and engineering-oriented gaze prediction rather than cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Transcranial low-level laser stimulation in near infrared-II region for brain safety and protection
papers.reason: It assesses human executive function and records EEG primarily to establish stimulation safety, without sufficient task, eye-tracking, spectral-connectivity, or cognitive-model detail.
